text:
I couldn't find the repository on this machine, so this verdict comes from reading the diff alone; I did not build it or run the complexity analyser.

APPROVE
The refactor moves the dependency walk, the name lookup, the input predicate and the message construction into helpers without changing their logic or iteration order, which removes the nested loops and boolean chains that made up most of the score of 29, though the build is unconfirmed because the helper signatures assume type names (`JsInventory.Inventory`, `CiChangeFilter`, `TestInvocation`) and a new class-level `Under` that I couldn't check against the rest of the partial class.
